title: TripScape
summary: A collaborative trip planner where Kanban, calendar and map views stay in sync in real time.

caseStudy.problem: Several people planning one trip need to edit the same plan at once, across a Kanban board, a calendar and a map, without the views drifting apart.
whatIDid: Built a React and TypeScript front end on an async FastAPI and PostgreSQL back end.
Wrote one state-management layer that keeps the Kanban, calendar and map views in sync.
Added real-time multi-user editing with per-trip WebSocket broadcasts from the service layer.
Added client-side auto-reconnect and self-echo suppression so optimistic updates don’t flicker.
Set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
outcome: Shipped on Google Cloud Run, Vercel and Neon Postgres.

title: NewsChecker
summary: A fine-tuned DeBERTa model that flags political bias in news sentences, with about 41% less error than a GPT-4o-mini baseline.

caseStudy.problem: Detect political bias at the sentence level in news articles, and check that the model still works on outlets and topics it hasn’t seen.
whatIDid: Fine-tuned DeBERTa-v3-base on 3,700 expert-annotated news sentences.
Designed outlet-holdout and topic-holdout ablations with in-distribution controls to isolate out-of-distribution gaps.
Compared against a GPT-4o-mini zero-shot baseline on a seeded 200-sentence holdout.
outcome: Macro F1 0.870 ± 0.005 and ROC AUC 0.937 across 3 random seeds, with bootstrap 95% confidence intervals.
Cut classification error by about 41% versus the GPT-4o-mini baseline (macro F1 0.87 vs 0.78).
Threshold tuning raised biased-class F1 to 0.92.

title: Pairs Trading Engine with Kalman Filter
summary: A pairs-trading backtest that tracks a time-varying hedge ratio with a Kalman filter. Out-of-sample Sharpe 1.1.

caseStudy.problem: A fixed OLS hedge ratio drifts over time and carries errors-in-variables bias, which weakens a pairs-trading signal.
whatIDid: Screened cointegrated equity pairs with Engle-Granger and ADF tests, using Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
Used a Kalman filter to track a time-varying hedge ratio instead of OLS.
Backtested 15+ years with causal z-score signals and 5 bps trading costs.
outcome: Out-of-sample Sharpe ratio of 1.1, with maximum drawdown under 12%.

title: Market Regime Detection & Strategy Switching
summary: A Gaussian HMM, built from scratch, that detects market regimes and sizes positions for each one.

caseStudy.problem: One strategy rarely suits every market. Spotting the current regime makes it possible to size positions to match.
whatIDid: Built a Gaussian HMM from scratch (Baum-Welch EM and Viterbi) on volatility, VIX and skewness features.
Chose the number of regimes with BIC and checked them against the 2008 financial crisis, 2020 COVID crash and 2022 rate shock.
Applied causal, forward-only filtering and Kelly-criterion sizing per regime.
